programme.title: Jurassic Park: O Parque dos Dinossauros
programme.desc: 1993. Um empresário bilionário convida um grupo de paleontólogos para fazer uma visita a um parque temático repleto de dinossauros regenerados a partir de DNA pré-histórico. Após uma queda de energia, as criaturas escapam e passam a atacar os visitantes. Gêneros: Ação, Aventura, Suspense Elenco: Sam Neill, Laura Dern, Jeff Goldblum Diretor: Steven Spielberg

programme.title: John Wick - De Volta ao Jogo
programme.desc: 2014. John Wick é um lendário assassino de aluguel aposentado que lida com o luto após perder o grande amor de sua vida. Um gângster invade sua casa, mata seu cachorro e rouba seu carro e ele é forçado a voltar à ativa para iniciar sua vingança. Gêneros: Ação, Drama, Mistério Elenco: Keanu Reeves, Michael Nyqvist, Alfie Allen Diretor: Chad Stahelski

programme.title: Respire
programme.desc: 2024. Mãe e filha sobrevivem em um mundo sem oxigênio e precisam cuidar uma da outra. Gêneros: Suspense Elenco: Jennifer Hudson, Milla Jovovich, Quvenzhané Wallis Diretor: Stefon Bristol

programme.title: Fúria de Titãs
programme.desc: 2010. Perseu, filho mortal de Zeus, encontra-se entre a batalha dos deuses e sem ajuda para salvar sua família da vingança de seu tio Hades, o deus do submundo. Ele lidera um grupo de guerreiros em uma perigosa missão para impedir a devastação na Terra. Gêneros: Ação, Fantasia, Aventura Elenco: Sam Worthington, Liam Neeson, Ralph Fiennes Diretor: Louis Leterrier

programme.title: As Verdades
programme.desc: 2022. O policial Josué tenta desvendar quem é o culpado por um crime cometido contra Valmir, candidato a prefeito de um pequeno município do sertão. Ele ouve as versões de Cícero, um matador de aluguel, Francisca, a noiva da vítima, e a do próprio Valmir. Gêneros: Drama, Policial Elenco: Lázaro Ramos, Bianca Bin, Drica Moraes Diretor: José Eduardo Belmonte

programme.title: Jogador Nº 1
programme.desc: 2018. Em 2045, Wade Watts, assim como o resto da humanidade, prefere a realidade virtual do jogo OASIS ao mundo real. James Halliday, o criador do jogo, morre e deixa sua fortuna para a primeira pessoa que descobrir a chave de um quebra-cabeça diabólico. Gêneros: Ação, Fantasia, Aventura Elenco: Tye Sheridan, Olivia Cooke, Ben Mendelsohn Diretor: Steven Spielberg

programme.title: John Wick 4: Baba Yaga
programme.desc: 2023. O ex-assassino de aluguel John Wick é procurado pelo mundo todo e a recompensa por sua captura aumenta cada vez mais. Wick descobre um caminho para derrotar a Alta Cúpula, mas antes de conquistar sua liberdade, ele precisa enfrentar um novo inimigo. Gêneros: Ação Elenco: Keanu Reeves, Laurence Fishburne, Lance Reddick Diretor: Chad Stahelski

programme.title: Espiral - O Legado de Jogos Mortais
programme.desc: 2021. O detetive Zeke Banks investiga o caso de um assassino em série que está seguindo os passos de Jigsaw. Involuntariamente, ele se vê preso no centro do jogo mórbido do homicida. Gêneros: Terror, Mistério, Suspense Elenco: Chris Rock, Max Minghella, Samuel L. Jackson Diretor: Darren Lynn Bousman

programme.title: Jornada para o Inferno
programme.desc: 2022. Um jovem se une a um grupo de caçadores de búfalo em uma jornada que arrisca sua vida e sanidade. Gêneros: Faroeste, Aventura Elenco: Nicolas Cage, Fred Hechinger, Rachel Keller Diretor: Gabe Polsky

programme.title: Jogos Mortais V
programme.desc: 2008. Mark Hoffman é, aparentemente, a última pessoa viva disposta a seguir o legado deixado por Jigsaw. Porém, quando seu segredo é ameaçado, ele precisa iniciar uma caçada para eliminar todos os envolvidos. Gêneros: Terror, Suspense Elenco: Tobin Bell, Costas Mandylor, Scott Patterson Diretor: David Hackl

programme.title: Heróis de Fogo
programme.desc: 2020. Um grupo de bombeiros enfrenta um dos mais devastadores incêndios florestais. O que alguns chamam de um ato de bravura é apenas rotina para eles. Gêneros: Ação, Drama Elenco: Konstantin Khabensky, Ivan Yankovskiy, Stasya Miloslavskaya Diretor: Alexey Nuzhny

programme.title: Resistência
programme.desc: 2023. Em um futuro de guerra entre humanos e inteligência artificial, um ex-agente das forças especiais que sofre pelo desaparecimento de sua esposa é recrutado para matar um arquiteto de IA que desenvolveu uma arma que pode eliminar a humanidade. Gêneros: Ação, Aventura Elenco: John David Washington, Madeleine Yuna Voyles, Gemma Chan Diretor: Gareth Edwards

programme.title: Fúria em Alto Mar
programme.desc: 2018. O capitão de um submarino norte-americano se une aos fuzileiros navais para resgatar o presidente russo, sequestrado por um general desonesto. Gêneros: Ação, Suspense Elenco: Gerard Butler, Gary Oldman, Common Diretor: Donovan Marsh

programme.title: A Protetora
programme.desc: 2020. Ali começa a trabalhar como zeladora em um abastado prédio de Nova York após um longo tempo servindo ao exército. Porém, uma simpática família é feita de refém, e ela precisa usar suas habilidades para salvá-los. Gêneros: Ação, Suspense Elenco: Ruby Rose, Jean Reno, Aksel Hennie Diretor: Ryûhei Kitamura

programme.title: 57 Segundos
programme.desc: 2023. Um blogueiro de tecnologia descobre um anel que permite viajar 57 segundos no passado. Entre milhões de dólares, carros e mansões, ele decide usar o objeto para se vingar da empresa responsável pela morte de sua irmã. Gêneros: Ação, Suspense Elenco: Josh Hutcherson, Morgan Freeman, Greg Germann Diretor: Rusty Cundieff

programme.title: A Força em Alerta
programme.desc: 1992. Terroristas embarcam em um navio de guerra que está prestes a ser desativado. O grupo planeja roubar o arsenal nuclear da embarcação, mas antes terá que lidar com um agente especial que também está a bordo, disfarçado de cozinheiro. Gêneros: Ação Elenco: Steven Seagal, Tommy Lee Jones, Gary Busey Diretor: Andrew Davis

programme.title: Teledeporte
programme.desc: Conexión con la programación del canal temático de deportes de Radiotelevisión Española, Teledeporte.El objetivo de este canal, que emite 24 horas diarias a través de diversos operadores de cable y televisión digital terrestre, es la promoción del deporte español, mediante programas de producción propia dedicados al análisis de la actualidad, al acercamiento a los deportistas y a la valoración de sus esfuerzos. Teledeporte dedica especial atención a los grandes eventos deportivos tales como los Juegos Olímpicos, o las finales más importantes de diferentes modalidades. Pero también ofrece todo aquello relacionado con los deportes que tradicionalmente han sido considerados minoritarios como, por ejemplo, el hockey hierba, hockey patines, gimnasia rítmica, judo o waterpolo.

programme.title: Ceuta desde dentro - Al otro lado de la frontera
programme.desc: En Castillejos conocemos a Lola, una madrileña que vive muy cerca de Ceuta, y en Martil a Ismael, otro madrileño que nos cuenta cómo se está viviendo la situación desde Marruecos. El eje humano del documental es la historia de Reda, un menor de Tetuán que lleva dos meses viviendo en Ceuta. Viajamos hasta Tetuán para conocer a su madre y entrar en la casa familiar, donde nos cuenta que nunca quiso que su hijo se marchara y que solo desea que regrese. La investigación culmina siguiendo e.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Teams begin their adventure from Times Square in New York City, where host Phil Keoghan introduces a new game-changing element, "The Save."

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.sub-title: When You Gotta Go, You Gotta Go
programme.desc: The Race continues through London, England, where the Express Pass is on the line, but several teams' hopes of a first-place finish are capsized while boating in a punt in Oxford.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: The Race makes its first-ever visit to the Shetland Islands in Scotland, where teams must corral an unruly flock of sheep down a winding obstacle course.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: When tasked with a painstaking Detour, the Dentists face the realization that they may need to use "The Save." Meanwhile, one team's lack of communication leads to a massive meltdown on the mat.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: With a double U-turn looming, emotions run high when two teams accuse each other of playing dirty.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.sub-title: I Feel Like I Just Kissed A Goat
programme.desc: Racers struggle on a frightening Road Block when they're suspended high above the Atlas Mountains.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.sub-title: Pretty Fly For A Food Scientist
programme.desc: THE AMAZING RACE takes off on its milestone 300th leg as teams race through Palermo, Sicily. Two rival teams form unlikely alliances and Racers battle to beat the clock in a high-octane go-cart race through the mountains.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: For the first time in series history, the show travels to Valletta, Malta, where teams are thrown off balance when challenged to serve drinks to the knights of Malta. Also, a blind detour leaves Racers on a slippery slope.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: One dangerous misstep leaves a Racer dangling 600 feet high in the Singapore sky, while a traditional Asian detox leaves several Teams writhing in pain.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Teams race to Manila, Philippines where they get muddy with an ornery Ox during a memorable switchback challenge from season five.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: On the penultimate leg of the Race, two strong teams make a potentially one-million-dollar mistake. Also, Phil Keoghan greets the teams with shocking news at the Pit Stop.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: For the first time ever, four teams battle it out in the final leg for the million-dollar prize, but one team will face a shocking elimination before making it to the finish line, on the season finale.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.sub-title: Great Way To Start A Relationship
programme.desc: For the first time, THE AMAZING RACE features 11 new teams of all dating duos: six who are preexisting couples, and five duos who meet for the first time at the starting line.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Teams race through Nagano, Japan where Racers take on an Olympic-sized Detour, and one team takes a tumble that may jeopardize their chances in the Race.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Tensions rise in Thailand as one team forgets their fanny pack, putting them behind, and one Racer celebrates the end of the leg when they pop a very special question.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Teams face a race within the Race when they attempt to navigate the chaotic streets of Bangkok, and Racers eat a traditional delicacy - a "1,000 year old egg."

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show
programme.desc: When the State Attorney's Office sends Andy a man to give practical lawman experience to, Barney believes Andy wants him to train a "replacement" deputy.

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show
programme.desc: An out-of-town speeder thinks Andy runs a speed trap in Mayberry. Awaiting her day in court gives her plenty of time to work on swaying the witnesses - Barney, Floyd and Opie.

programme.desc: The callous eviction of a down-on-his-luck elder citizen comes back to bite the town council when the man's uncashed municipal bond amounts to more than the town can pay.

programme.title: Didou

programme.title: Didou, construis-moi !
programme.desc: Didou et Yoko sont dans un parc. Ils entendent Monsieur Singe et Monsieur Putois se disputer pour savoir quelle est l'utilité de deux étranges objets. programme.title: Didou, construis-moi !
programme.desc: Didou et Yoko sont dans la forêt amazonnienne. Didou a alors une solution : construire un 4X4 pour se déplacer sur tous les types de terrain et ainsi découvrir de nouvelles espèces de plantes !

programme.title: Didou, construis-moi !

programme.title: Unterwegs in Tirol - Unterland

programme.title: La trepadora
programme.desc: La Trepadora narra el choque entre dos familias poderosas y orgullosas. Nicolás Del Casal, decidido a recuperar el honor que le arrebataron a su madre, regresa a las tierras de sus antepasados. Allí se enfrenta a secretos, traiciones y al dominio de los Peñalver, la familia rival.

programme.title: Hermanitas calle
programme.desc: La familia se apellida Calle. Son 4 hermanas, 1 hermano, la mamá, un tío y los novios. Dos de las hermanas son cantantes populares y consiguen un contrato discográfico, pero todos los miembros de la familia, incluyéndolas, atraviesan situaciones dramáticas. Tienen que enfrentar muchos problemas que no dejan de aparecer. Las dos protagonistas son las hermanas cantantes. Además, deben enfrentarse al alcalde corrupto y malvado, quien acusa falsamente a una de ellas y hace que termine en la cárcel.

programme.title: Esmeraldas

programme.title: Tosh.0: 624
programme.desc: Daniel undersøger, hvordan det er gået for tidligere netgenoprejsninger, udforsker menneskekroppens mange huller og fortæller om en ny måde at ødelægge sin økonomi på.

programme.title: Tosh.0: 625
programme.desc: Daniel giver en rødtop, som har fået bank af Moder Jord, netgenoprejsning, redder USA's ungdom fra fordømmelse og får skræmmende tweets fra sine fans, lige i tide til Halloween.

programme.title: Tosh.0: 626
programme.desc: Daniel fortæller "kysseteorien" til et par intimcoacher, giver os råd før næste gang vi skal bolle en beskidt luder og prøver at stoppe respektløse kommentarer til kvinder.

programme.title: Tosh.0: 627
programme.desc: Et bøssepar, der bliver nægtet adgang til en homofobisk restaurant, får genoprejsning, en Tosh.0-kopi bliver afsløret, og Daniel lærer den sande betydning af ironi.

programme.title: Tosh.0: 628
programme.desc: Daniel finder sin indre programvært frem, finder på en musical og afslører en regeringshemmelighed, som kan få globale følger.

programme.title: Tosh.0: 629
programme.desc: I det her juleafsnit finder Daniel ud af, hvem der skød den sorte julemand, viser sin værste "jeg er bedre end dig, bæ i dit fjæs" og afslører en gammel familieopskrift.

programme.title: Tosh.0: 630
programme.desc: Daniel ser tilbage på alle de øjeblikke, der gjorde 2014 så forfærdelig, ser ind i fremtiden med Doug Stanhope og går uanmeldt til en skodagtig forlovelsesfest.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Puke Drummer
programme.desc: I sæsonspremieren på "Tosh.0" sætter Daniel nogle af årets mest hyldede film på plads, og han erklærer krig mod Super Bowl-vinderne.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Buckcherry Wedding
programme.desc: En kvinde bliver en gift med maner, Daniel introducerer sadomasochisme på kontoret og ASU opfører sig distraherende.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Monster Energy
programme.desc: En gudfrygtig kvinde fører en kampagne mod energidrikke og Daniel afslører, hvordan seerne kan blive rige ved at bruge deres computere.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Shoenice
programme.desc: En vagabond får en kendisprofil, et kritikerkryb får ris og Daniel gør en indsats for at bekæmpe racisme i USA.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Jackie B.
programme.desc: Daniel laver et remix sammen med en rapgudinde, renser internettet bit for bit og skaber en ny hashtag for at styrke kvinder.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Sting Wrestling Fan
programme.desc: Daniel tager brydergreb på en wrestlingfan, bliver grillet af millioner af sine nærmeste venner og gør gaden sikker for moderigtige folk alle vegne.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Atheist In A Foxhole
programme.desc: Daniel profilerer en hedning i halterneck, fortæller om sit eksklusive møde med en politiker fra Alaska og skriver en sang til studenterfyre, der ikke er racistisk, chauvinistisk eller stødende.

programme.title: Tosh.0: RC Car
programme.desc: En radiostyret bils netoprettelse bliver lidt 'Fast' og lidt 'Furious', 'Tosh.0'-personalet spiser menneskemad og Daniel bliver scientolog, kendissernes officielle religion.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Sign Spinner
programme.desc: Daniel taler med en tamburmajor, der får mindsteløn, hylder de modige mænd og kvinder som bærer falske uniformer og skænker lidt veltrængt fugtighed til Californien.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Girl Dunks
programme.desc: Daniel giver en Juwanna Mann-wannebee netoprettelse, forvandler nedladende homofobiske skældsord til kvalitetsprodukter og møder en meget usædvanlig baby.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Microwave Glow Stick
programme.desc: Daniel giver en knægt, der ikke er mikroovnssikker netoprettelse, søger at efterligne talkshows med dumme quizzer i stedet for at være sjov og gør det sjovt at sørge over ens elskede.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Fedora Hero Saves Eggs
programme.desc: Daniel løfter på hatten for en ydmygt pralende helt, taler med sig selv som teenager og hjælper to usædvanlige mennesker med at finde hinanden.

programme.title: Tosh.0: High School Football Fan
programme.desc: Daniel profilerer en unik high school-footballfan, beviser, at han er bedre end alle andre og viser, at bladblæsere kan være farlige, hvis de ikke anvendes korrekt.

programme.title: Tosh.0: How To Give A BJ
programme.desc: Daniel får oralsex-tip fra den mest ulækre fyr på YouTube, introducer en modstandsdygtig baby og afslører Hollywoods mest beskidte hemmelighed.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Where Are They Now? Part 3
programme.desc: Før Daniels sommerferie tjekker han ind hos Tosh.0 legenderne, konfronterer sine mest irriterende fans og kommer med en bekendtgørelse, der vil ryste filmindustrien i sin grundvold.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Angelo Garcia, He-Man
programme.desc: Daniel lader os møde en tidligere barnestjerne, der klæder sig ud som He-Man, viser at havrekager forvandler folk til løgnere og sælger sine mest værdifulde ejendele.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Welven Da Great
programme.desc: Daniel sidder ned med "Deez Nuts", Welven Da Great, og gør det sikkert for børn at spise sandwicher igen og bliver sexet med sine fans ørehuller.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Car Jump Kid
programme.desc: Daniel leger i trafikken med en "amatørstuntfyr", finder ud af, om han stadig er den mest begavede i familien og giver råd til tipsspillere.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Annie Don't Fall
programme.desc: Daniel lader dit publikum få en plads i rampelyset og lærer, hvordan man viser, at man er klar til NFL.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Vegan Guy
programme.desc: Daniel får besøg af en vulgær vegansk sanger, snakker med en fyr, der har for meget tid (og tape) og promoverer gode erektioner for alle.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Rifle Kid
programme.desc: Daniel ser nærmere på våbenvold og sørger for at finde plads til at ansætte sexede rekrutter til kontoret og viser, hvor det er bedre at spytte end at sluge.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Ladies' Night: A Female Empowerment Episode
programme.sub-title: Ladies' Night: A Female Empowerment Episode
programme.desc: Det er damernes aften og Daniel lovpriser alt det, kvinder elsker, inklusive sexede mænd som kan danse, at vise følelser og derudover byder han på kendissladder.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Kitten Play
programme.desc: Daniel siger hej til en særlig mis og demonstrerer den mest uhyggelige måde at holde en iPhone på og USA's liderligste nye spil får sin debut.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Sword Nose
programme.desc: Daniel krydser sværd med to fra Mississippis elite, beviser at han er en internetsærling har brug for en ven og gør sit personale moderigtigt ved hjælp af en saks.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Tosh.0 Memorabilia Auction #2

programme.title: Tosh.0: Elephant Lady
programme.desc: Daniel bliver kunstnerisk med en særling, beviser at en 40-årig komiker kan være lige så sexet som en ung popstjerne og taler med de mest triste folk i verden: Detroit Lions-fans.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Catfish Cooley
programme.desc: Daniel lærer mere om Catfish Cooley og afslører den bedste måde at tackle en Georgia-dulle på.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Possum Lady
programme.desc: En excentrisk kvinde byder Daniel velkommen i sit opossum-rige, Tosh.O's publikum bruger deres tankekraft til at flytte skyer og Daniel fotobomber kunstverdenen.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Arm Wrestle Break
programme.desc: Daniel giver en britisk "bird" med to brækkede vinger en ny chance og spiser kage med nettets nyeste dessertdiva.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Best Of Season 7
programme.desc: I sæsonafslutningen disser Daniel 2015 og finder ud af, hvad der sker med menneskeligt blod i 3000 meters højde.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Pixee Fox

programme.desc: Dansează hopa - hopa este cea mai bună opțiune pentru copiii energici, dornici de țopăială. Pot fi incluse și cântecele tematice în engleză.

programme.title: Un’ doi suntem vioi
programme.desc: Un`, doi, suntem vioi! conține cântece potrivite pentru exerciții fizice și motricitate, pentru a începe activitățile cât mai vioi. Este mult mai plăcut să faci înviorare/educație fizică pe un fond muzical care te ajută să păstrezi ritmul/cadența, cu versuri care îți comunică mișcările și îți spun că e bine și sănătos să faci sport.

programme.title: Grădinița Tralala
programme.desc: Grădinița TraLaLa își dorește să vină în ajutorul cadrelor didactice din sistemul preșcolar și, cu ajutorul cântecelelor, să facă programul educațional mai simplu și mai plăcut de asimilat.

programme.title: Carusel muzical
programme.desc: Carusel muzical este un mix compus din cântece cu tematică variată, adaptat anotimpului sau evenimentelor marcante precum ziua copilului, ziua mamei, începutul școlii, vacanță de vară.

programme.title: Ora de engleză
programme.desc: Limba engleză poate fi mult mai accesibilă și mult mai agreabilă dacă este predată/învățată cu ajutorul cântecelelor. Există, deja, o mulțime de studii de specialitate care recomandă - pentru educația timpurie (0-3 ani) și, în general,preșcolarilor, această metodă de familiarizare cu o limbă străină.

programme.title: Zigaloo și prietenii
programme.desc: De regulă, primul cântecel pe care îl învață un copil este despre un animăluț (cățeluș, pisicuță etc.) Cântecelele cu și despre animale sunt cele mai apreciate fiindcă, în primii ani, toți copiii se familiarizează cu animalele, mai ales prin intermediul jucăriilor. Toți învață - repede și ușor - sunetele pe care le scot animalele. Ele devin parte din lumea lor și pot fi asociate cu orice fel de activități - educative sau distractive - pe care copiii le vor accepta și le vor îndrăgi și mai mult, prezentate fiind prin intermediul animalelor. Învață,totodată, despre animale, să le aprecieze și să le ocrotească.

programme.title: Escuadrón 633
programme.desc: Durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial, Eric Bergman, soldado escandinavo, revela al ejército británico el paradero de una planta donde los nazis almacenan el combustible necesario para fabricar una bomba atómica. La plana está escondida en un recóndito fiordo noruego de difícil acceso. Por lo que el ejército británico ve en un ataque aéreo la única posibilidad de destruirla. Esa misión es encomendada al escuadrón 633, liderado por el comandante Roy Grant. Cliff Robertson ('Charly') y George Chakiris ('West Side Story') protagonizan este drama bélico, muy parecido en su fondo y forma a la clásica 'Los cañones de Navarone', que se basa en la historia real del legendario cazabombardero mosquito. La película, adaptada a partir de la novela homónima de Frederick E. Smith por los reputados guionistas Howard Dock ('Casablanca') y James Clavell ('Rebelión en las aulas'), fue dirigida por el afamado realizador televisivo Walter Grauman ('Los intocables', 'Se ha escrito un crimen'), quien contó con los efectos especiales más avanzados de la época y con un grupo de especialistas acróbatas, que realizaron algunas de las escenas aéreas más espectaculares jamás rodadas hasta el momento.

programme.title: The Great Divide
programme.desc: Posing as a bandido, a businessman abducts a Roaring '20s flapper hoping to reform her.

programme.title: Show of Shows
programme.desc: The Warner Bros. revue, with master of ceremonies (Frank Fay), begins with 192 dancing girls on a huge staircase.

programme.title: The Truth About Youth
programme.desc: A naive young man becomes enamored of a cabaret singer who has sampled liberally from amongst the male population.

programme.title: The Naughty Flirt
programme.desc: A spoiled heiress leaves her boyfriend only to become involved with a man who secretly desires her money.

programme.title: Consolation Marriage
programme.desc: A sportswriter (Pat O'Brien) jilted by his globe-trotting girlfriend (Myrna Loy) marries a woman (Irene Dunne) jilted by her boyfriend.

programme.title: Rebound
programme.desc: A woman (Ina Claire) tries to make her husband (Robert Ames) forget his old flame (Myrna Loy), who is back.

programme.title: Libeled Lady
programme.desc: When a major newspaper accuses wealthy socialite Connie Allenbury (Myrna Loy) of being a home-wrecker, and she files a multi-million-dollar libel lawsuit, the publication's frazzled head editor, Warren Haggerty (Spencer Tracy), must find a way to turn the tables on her. Soon Haggerty's harried fiancée, Gladys Benton (Jean Harlow), and his dashing friend Bill Chandler (William Powell) are in on a scheme that aims to discredit Connie, with amusing and unexpected results.

programme.title: I Love You Again
programme.desc: Larry Wilson (William Powell) is a wealthy businessman. He's also so incredibly boring that his wife, Kay (Myrna Loy), wants a divorce. But when Larry gets knocked on the head, he discovers that he isn't Larry Wilson at all. He's actually George Carey, a con artist, and his life as Larry has really been a case of amnesia. Now back to his old ways, George plans a con to rob an entire town of their money. But George's fiery ways make Kay reconsider the divorce.

programme.title: Love Crazy
programme.desc: A happily married architect, Steve (William Powell), and his wife, Susan (Myrna Loy), plan a romantic celebration for their fourth anniversary, but their evening is interrupted when Susan's meddling mother, Mrs. Cooper (Florence Bates), stops by for a visit. Later, when Mrs. Cooper eavesdrops on Steve talking with an old flame, Isobel (Gail Patrick), she tells Susan, who files for divorce. Steve, still in love with Susan, decides he must feign insanity to stop the divorce proceedings.

programme.title: Double Wedding
programme.desc: The industrious Margit Agnew (Myrna Loy) fixes her sister Irene (Florence Rice) up with the sensible but meek Waldo Beaver (John Beal), and the couple soon decides to wed, despite Irene's reservations about her boring fiancé. Things take a sharp turn when Irene makes the acquaintance of eccentric artist Charles Lodge (William Powell), who encourages the young woman to drop Waldo and pursue her dreams. Before long, an irate Margit confronts Charles, but their encounter takes an unexpected turn.

programme.title: Evelyn Prentice
programme.desc: John Prentice (William Powell) is a successful attorney who often overlooks his wife, Evelyn (Myrna Loy), as he flirts with other women. When Nancy Harrison (Rosalind Russell), a lovely young client, distracts John, Evelyn takes her own steps towards an affair. However, the man interested in Evelyn turns out to be a criminal, and, in a frantic state, she shoots him. Soon, John is brought on to the case, but suspicions point away from Evelyn. Will she admit her involvement?

programme.title: Manhattan Melodrama
programme.desc: Jim Wade and Blackie Gallagher are two boys orphaned by the sinking of a ship. Upon the death of their guardian, also a survivor of the sinking, the boys go their separate ways. Jim (William Powell) grows up to have a prominent political career, while Blackie (Clark Gable) becomes a casino owner and killer. Despite Blackie's lifestyle, the two men remain bonded through thick and thin. But when Jim runs for governor, his association with Blackie threatens his chances.

programme.title: The Great Ziegfeld
programme.desc: This lively biopic depicts the rise of Florenz Ziegfeld (William Powell), a theater producer who became renowned during the 1920s for his lavish stage productions. Starting out by promoting individual performers, Ziegfeld established revues featuring dozens of women, shows that developed into his famous Ziegfeld Follies on Broadway. His appreciation of women is also apparent off-stage, leading to a love triangle involving actresses Anna Held (Luise Rainer) and Billie Burke (Myrna Loy).

programme.title: A Midsummer Night's Dream
programme.desc: In this classic screen adaptation of Shakespeare's fantastical play, the royal wedding plans of Theseus, the duke of Athens (Ian Hunter) and Hippolyta overlap with the antics of forest fairies, led by Oberon and Titania, and a ragtag troupe of actors. Meanwhile, young lovers, including Lysander (Dick Powell) and Hermia (Olivia de Havilland), deceive each other in amusing ways, and magic adds a mischievous element to this enchanted romantic comedy.

programme.title: Hitler's Madman
programme.desc: The Nazi Heinrich Himmler condemns the Czech village Lidice after partisans kill the Nazi Reinhard Heydrich (John Carradine).

programme.title: Escape From East Berlin
programme.desc: After East Berlin chauffeur Kurt Schroder (Don Murray) decides to escape to West Germany, he begins a plan to dig a tunnel under the Berlin Wall. Soon members of Kurt's family are in on the highly risky endeavor, with friends such as the pretty Erika Jurgens (Christine Kaufmann) also joining the effort. As the group tries to execute its plan, Kurt and the others worry about patrolling police and nosy neighbors, fearing they will be discovered before they can complete the tunnel.

programme.title: Friendly Persuasion
programme.desc: The patriarch of a peace-loving Quaker family, Jess Birdwell, begins to question his pacifist values when the Civil War moves toward his close-knit Indiana community. Meanwhile, Jess's daughter, Mattie, is in love with a soldier, and her brother, Josh, contemplates picking up arms to defend his home lest he be considered a coward. As Confederate forces draw nearer, the Birdwells must make some difficult, life-altering decisions.

programme.title: Fury
programme.desc: Joe Wilson (Spencer Tracy) is an innocent man wrongly accused of a horrible crime while on his way to meet his fiancée, Katherine Grant (Sylvia Sidney). Held at a local jail, Joe is confronted by a frenzied mob and presumed dead after a massive fire. When his attackers aren't brought to justice, Joe, who narrowly escaped the blaze, resurfaces, intent on revenge. Katherine tries to dissuade him from carrying out his vengeful plan, but Joe's anger isn't easily dampened.

programme.title: And Then There Were None
programme.desc: In this suspenseful drama, based on Agatha Christie's mystery tale, 10 strangers are summoned to a remote island. While they are waiting for the mysterious host to appear, a recording levels serious accusations at each of the guests, including Judge Francis J. Quinncannon (Barry Fitzgerald) and Dr. Edward G. Armstrong (Walter Huston), and soon they start being murdered, one by one. As the survivors try to keep their wits, they reach a disturbing conclusion: one of them must be the killer.

programme.sub-title: Devotees come together to participate in a pilgrimage to visit the 12 Jyotirlingas, which are considered a divine manifestation of Lord Shiva
programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality

programme.title: भक्ति प्रवाह
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back

programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.title: जानबाज़ मुर्गा
programme.sub-title: A fun-loving chicken along with his friends embark on various adventures, as they overcome challenges and share heartfelt moments
programme.desc: एक मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला मुर्गा अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों पर निकलता है, जहां वे चुनौतियों पर विजय प्राप्त करते हैं और दिल को छू लेने वाले पल साझा करते हैं।.

programme.desc: एक दुष्ट लकड़हारा जंगल को अपना निजी लकड़हारा बनाने का फ़ैसला करता है। लेकिन, दो भालू भाइयों, बबलू और डबलू, द्वारा उसे रोकने के फ़ैसले के बाद चीज़ें बदल जाती हैं।.

programme.title: हनी बनी
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: 12 ज्योतिर्लिंग दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Devotees come together to participate in a pilgrimage to visit the 12 Jyotirlingas, which are considered a divine manifestation of Lord Shiva
programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.title: धर्म कथा
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: Sneakers
programme.desc: An ex-'60s-radical computer hacker (Robert Redford) and his company are tapped for a shady black-box job.","large":"Computer hacker Martin (Robert Redford) heads a group of specialists who test the security of various San Francisco companies. Martin is approached by two National Security Agency officers who ask him to steal a newly invented decoder. Martin and his team discover that the black box can crack any encryption code, posing a huge threat if it lands in the wrong hands. When Martin realizes the NSA men who approached him are rogue agents, they frame him for the murder of the device's inventor.

programme.title: The Car
programme.desc: A Western deputy sheriff (James Brolin) chases a driverless black car that keeps running people down.","large":"Two bicyclists are run down by a strange black car in the desert near a small town in Utah. But this is just the first in a series of hit-and-run murders. Sheriff Wade Parent is called in to investigate, and his deputy, Everett, is killed by the black sedan, which, some witnesses say, has no one behind its wheel. When the car threatens a local school parade, the lives of the town's children and Wade's teacher girlfriend, Lauren, are endangered.

programme.title: Black Dog
programme.desc: A trucker with a vehicular manslaughter conviction agrees to drive a suspicious shipment for his boss.","large":"An ex-con takes a job truck driving across the country. However, the truck is filled with illegal weapons, and now he must fight to save his family. The stakes are high as gun runners, government agents and a fleet of monstrous 18-wheelers pursue him in an intense highway duel.

programme.title: The Jackal
programme.desc: A jailed IRA operative (Richard Gere) helps the FBI track a masterful assassin (Bruce Willis) about to perform a political killing.","large":"During an FBI raid on a Moscow nightclub, the brother of Russian gangster Terek Murad (David Hayman) is killed. Murad wants revenge and hires anonymous hit man the Jackal (Bruce Willis) to kill FBI Deputy Director Carter Preston (Sidney Poitier). With the help of Russian agent Valentina Koslova (Diane Venora), Preston finds the only man who knows what the notorious Jackal looks like, imprisoned IRA terrorist Declan Mulqueen (Richard Gere), and forces him to help hunt down the hit man.

programme.title: Mercury Rising
programme.desc: An FBI renegade (Bruce Willis) tries to stop his nemesis (Alec Baldwin) from killing an autistic boy (Miko Hughes) who cracked a government code.","large":""Mercury Rising" stars Bruce Willis as Art Jeffries, a renegade FBI agent who combats ruthless federal agents to protect Simon (Miko Hughes), a 9-year-old autistic boy who has cracked the government's new unbreakable code. He can read MERCURY, the most advanced encryption code yet created, as easily as other kids read English. This ability renders the new billion-dollar secret code vulnerable, especially if enemies of the United States should learn of Simon's abilities and capture him.

programme.title: End of Days
programme.desc: An ex-cop (Arnold Schwarzenegger) must protect a woman chosen by Satan (Gabriel Byrne) to be the mother of the Antichrist.","large":"With the millennium approaching, a series of disturbing signs suggests that Satan (Arnold Schwarzenegger) has returned to Earth and is walking the streets of New York City. It seems that Satan needs to find a woman who will bear his child, as the time for the arrival of the anti-Christ draws near.

programme.title: The Darkness
programme.desc: A supernatural force terrorizes a couple (Kevin Bacon, Radha Mitchell) and their two children after the young son brings home some mysterious rocks from the Grand Canyon.","large":"Peter Taylor (Kevin Bacon), his wife Bronny and their two children return to Los Angeles after a fun-filled vacation to the Grand Canyon. Strange events soon start to plague the family, including young son Michael's increasingly erratic behavior. The Taylors learn that Michael brought back some mysterious rocks that he discovered inside a cave. Unfortunately, something followed them home as the clan now find themselves in a battle with a supernatural force that preys on their worst fears.

programme.title: Blues Brothers 2000
programme.desc: Newly released from prison, Elwood Blues (Dan Aykroyd) reassembles the Blues Brothers Band with new members (John Goodman, Joe Morton).","large":"The now-brotherless Ellwood Blues (Dan Aykroyd) is finally out of prison, attempting to reunite the old band and find a few new partners in crime (John Goodman), (J. Evan Bonifant). In this sequel to the original "Blues Brothers" comedy/musical, Ellwood battles the Chicago police, sings and dances his way out of numerous sticky situations, and manages to get the old band on the road for a hair-raising adventure.

programme.title: Bird on a Wire
programme.desc: An FBI-relocated witness (Mel Gibson) and his ex-girlfriend (Goldie Hawn) from the '60s are chased by the drug thug (David Carradine) he sent to prison.","large":"Rick Jarmin (Mel Gibson) is put in witness protection after he helps the FBI bust drug dealer Eugene Sorenson (David Carradine). Fifteen years later, he is living with a new identity as a gas station attendant in Detroit. When an old flame named Marianne (Goldie Hawn) stops at the gas station and recognizes him, his cover gets blown. The recently released Sorenson finds out, and both Jarmin and Marianne have to flee across the country with the vengeful Sorenson in hot pursuit.

programme.title: Serial Mom
programme.desc: A seemingly perfect wife and mother (Kathleen Turner) from Baltimore gains celebrity status as a serial killer.

programme.title: Altered
programme.desc: Fifteen years after they were abducted by aliens, four men get a chance to take revenge when they capture one of the creatures.","large":"Forever damaged by their stint as the scientific subjects of hostile alien creatures, a trio of alien-abduction survivors -- Otis (Michael C. Williams), Duke (Brad William Henke) and Cody (Paul McCarthy-Boyington) -- troll the wooded site of their disappearance, heavily armed, in search of their attackers. After wounding a violent alien in the woods, the three drag its dying body to the home of reclusive fellow abductee Wyatt (Adam Kaufman), barricade themselves in and prepare for the worst.

programme.title: White Noise
programme.desc: An architect (Michael Keaton) believes his dead wife (Chandra West) is using electronic devices to communicate with him.","large":"Architect Jonathan Rivers (Michael Keaton) is happily married to author Anna (Chandra West), but tragedy strikes when she is killed in an accident. Deep in grief, Jonathan hears from Raymond Price (Ian McNeice), who claims that he has intercepted messages from Anna via electronic voice phenomena. Jonathan eventually comes to believe Raymond's claims, but, as he is drawn further into investigating the phenomenon, a sinister supernatural presence invades his life.

programme.title: White Noise 2: The Light
programme.desc: After nearly being killed along with his family, a man recovers and realizes that he can sense when someone is about to die.","large":"A man's family is killed, but he survives -- barely. After recovering, he realizes that he has changed in some way: He now senses when someone is about to die. In his attempts to save people who are near death, he discovers there is a price to pay for interfering with the cosmos.

programme.title: The New Daughter
programme.desc: A single father (Kevin Costner) is puzzled by his daughter's (Ivana Baquero) weird behavior, which begins soon after he moves his family to a secluded woodland home.

programme.title: Mama
programme.desc: As a woman (Jessica Chastain) tries to reintroduce her lover's (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) traumatized nieces to a normal life, disturbing questions and occurrences suggest that a supernatural presence has followed the girls to her home.","large":"On the day that their parents die, sisters Lilly and Victoria vanish in the woods, prompting a frantic search by their Uncle Lucas (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) and his girlfriend, Annabel (Jessica Chastain). Five years later, miraculously, the girls are found alive in a decaying cabin, and Lucas and Annabel welcome them into their home. But as Annabel tries to reintroduce the children to a normal life, she finds that someone -- or something -- still wants to tuck them in at night.

programme.title: The Unborn
programme.desc: With the help of a spiritualist (Gary Oldman), a woman (Odette Yustman) uncovers a family curse dating back to Nazi Germany and involving a demonic spirit with the power to inhabit anything or anyone.","large":"Plagued by nightmares and visitations from tortured ghosts, Casey Beldon turns to a spiritual adviser named Sendak for help. They discover a family curse that dates back to Nazi Germany: an evil spirit that can take over the body of anyone and is getting stronger with each possession, as it tries to gain full entrance to this world.

programme.title: The Forest
programme.desc: While investigating the disappearance of her twin sister, a young American encounters the tormented spirits of Japan's mysterious and legendary Aokigahara Forest.","large":"When her twin sister disappears in Japan, a young American named Sara becomes determined to find out what happened to her. Sara's investigation leads her to the legendary Aokigahara Forest, located at the base of Mount Fuji. Accompanied by expatriate Aiden, she enters the mysterious wilderness after being warned to "stay on the path." Her investigation plunges her into a dark world where the angry and tormented souls of the dead prey on those who dare to explore the forest.

programme.title: Dead Silence
programme.desc: After his wife meets a grisly end, a man (Ryan Kwanten) returns to their haunted hometown and uncovers a supernatural link to her death.","large":"After his wife meets a grisly end, Jamie Ashen (Ryan Kwanten) returns to their creepy hometown of Ravens Fair to unravel the mystery of her murder. Once there, he discovers the legend of Mary Shaw (Joan Heney), a murdered ventriloquist whose eerie presence still looms over the town. As he desperately digs for answers, Jamie encounters the curse that took his wife's life and threatens his own.

programme.title: Unfriended
programme.desc: A teenager (Shelley Hennig) and her five friends (Moses Storm, Renee Olstead) become the prey of an unknown online presence that wants revenge for a shaming video that caused a classmate to kill herself one year prior.","large":"One night, while teenagers Blaire, Mitch, Jess, Adam Ken and Val take part in an online group chat session, they are suddenly joined by a user known only as "Billie227." Thinking it's just a technical glitch, the friends carry on their conversation... until Blaire begins receiving messages from someone claiming to be Laura Barns, a classmate who killed herself exactly one year prior. As Blaire tries to expose Billie's identity, her friends are forced to confront their darkest secrets and lies.
